## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes (CI runs it too)
- [ ] Every new number is backed by a source listed in the file's `sources`
- [ ] `confidence` follows the guide: high = the load's own series across barrel lengths, medium = a couple of lengths, low = one reading or the maker's rating
- [ ] Ids of existing loads are unchanged
